name: Momozono Jun
source:
The priestess of a fertility cult. Her father is the head of the cult and it's the duty of the women to become impregnated by the cult leaders. Jun is called Miko-hime by the members of the cult.

Secretly Jun wants to have her father's baby but she believes it's a crime.

Hideyuki convinces her that he's an angel and she should make a baby with him.
